profile.summary: Newsela is an education technology company that provides classroom reading content, curriculum materials and assessment tools for K-12 schools and districts. Its products cover English language arts, social studies, science and writing. The company launched in 2013.

review.notes: Newsela, Inc. matches the agenda name and New York, NY location, and its K-12 ELA/social studies/STEM/writing content fits an Academics and Instruction services and data sharing agreement. Name, address, support email, website and 2013 launch were confirmed on the cited pages; the summary is neutral.
